incidents.name: Annex Liquidator unvalidated flash-swap callback
incidents.notes: The Annex Liquidator's PancakeSwap flash-swap callback never verified that msg.sender was a legitimate factory pair, so the attacker created a pair for a worthless self-minted token and had it call the liquidator, draining its WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: Liquidator 0xe65E970F065643bA80E5822edfF483A1d75263E3 created 2022-11-17T07:31:44Z by 0x50086caf6a8b4aef941d6512ad0d2a25c48469a9, unrelated to attack sender 0x40fb8d322cc4887d6c2bf886755300ea79f6a874; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 7.2259 WBNB left the liquidator; 7.2259 WBNB x $272.38 at incidentTimestamp 1668786559 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $1,968.
